provenance.author: dnd-diceroll project agents (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5) for the repository owner
provenance.license: Project-owned original work; same terms as this repository
provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender 5.2.3 LTS, deep high fantasy with a PS1 look: the Root of the World identity (giant tree, roots, mossy flagstones, fungus, canopy light) from the owner-approved r001 Root (issue #38) and the #140 gate-1 decisions; all textures and geometry procedural; no third-party, kit, AI-service or downloaded content

recipe.method: Authored in Blender by script (build_kit_root_r002.py): small non-blocking Root scatter prop
recipe.approved_reference: Gate 1 decision on #140 (2026-11-08); #145 r002 standard; parent #138

parameters.units: metres at true scale for a 150 cm cell
parameters.pivot: centre of its cell, at floor level; non-blocking dressing, may be rotated freely
parameters.sampling: Linear, 8 px wrapped padding per atlas region
parameters.theme: Root of the World (Root encounters only; the Vigil kit is separate)

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed reimport (#149 phase 2, as #145)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: exempt: under ~1k triangles or a translucent card (no LOD exports)
settings.collision: none (presentation only; blocking comes from gameplay data)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB light, A glow mask)
settings.axes: metres, +X forward, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
